question: Find a single discount equivalent to successive discounts of 5% and 20%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Single equivalent discount % for two successive discounts a% and b% = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100

⇒ Equivalent Discount % = 5 + 20 − (5 × 20) ÷ 100

⇒ Equivalent Discount % = 25 − (100 ÷ 100)

⇒ Equivalent Discount % = 25 − 1 = 24%

**∴ The correct answer is 24%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First discount = 5%

Second discount = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (100 − D₁)/100 × (100 − D₂)/100

Equivalent Discount % = [(MP − SP) ÷ MP] × 100

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 MP
 
 100
 
 
• 
 −5%
 
 
 95
 
 
• 
 −20%
 
 SP
 
 76
 
 

 
• 
 Equivalent Discount = 100 − 76 = 24%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Marked Price (MP) be 100.

⇒ SP = 100 × (100 − 5)/100 × (100 − 20)/100

⇒ SP = 100 × 95/100 × 80/100

⇒ SP = 95 × 4/5

⇒ SP = 76

⇒ Total Discount = MP − SP

⇒ Total Discount = 100 − 76 = 24

⇒ Equivalent Discount % = (24 ÷ 100) × 100 = 24%

**∴ The correct answer is 24%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two discounts a% and b%, the effective single discount is a + b − (ab ÷ 100)%.

Three Successive Discounts

To find a single discount for a%, b%, and c%, first find the equivalent of a% and b%, and then apply the same formula with c%.

Ratio Method

Write each discount as a fraction to get the ratio of MP to SP. Multiply the individual parts to get the overall MP and SP, then calculate the total discount percentage.
